Joins pre-aggregated 2025 311 and code-violation counts per tract with CDC total population, computes per-1,000-resident rates, and returns every tract with the cross-tract correlation and paired-tract count ranked by 311 rate descending.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS req_311_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_c6a04b' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_c6a04b_population_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.name,
    t.geoid,
    COALESCE(c.req_311_count, 0) AS req_311_count,
    COALESCE(c.violations_count, 0) AS violations_count,
    p.totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
  WHERE p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  req_311_count,
  violations_count,
  totalpopulation,
  CAST(req_311_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000 AS req_311_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  CAST(violations_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000 AS violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  CORR(CAST(req_311_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000, CAST(violations_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000) OVER () AS corr_311_violations_per_1000_residents,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM base
ORDER BY req_311_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW answer_c6a04b WITH CONTAINER fieldwork_answers AS WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS req_311_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_c6a04b' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_c6a04b_population_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.name,
    t.geoid,
    COALESCE(c.req_311_count, 0) AS req_311_count,
    COALESCE(c.violations_count, 0) AS violations_count,
    p.totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
  WHERE p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  req_311_count,
  violations_count,
  totalpopulation,
  CAST(req_311_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000 AS req_311_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  CAST(violations_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000 AS violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
  CORR(CAST(req_311_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000, CAST(violations_count AS DOUBLE) / totalpopulation * 1000) OVER () AS corr_311_violations_per_1000_residents,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM base
ORDER BY req_311_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
